notes: Community is now a Biamp brand; current official datasheet labels this the "Desono ENT212" (Desono E Series), though it is widely sold and listed by retailers as "Community ENT212." Passive column line-array loudspeaker — no AC power input; powered entirely via external amplifier through the two speaker-level input connectors on the recessed input panel. The NL4-type connector is a 4-pole Neutrik Speakon (mapped to "speakon"). The "8-position terminal strip" is a barrier/terminal strip, not a true Euroblock, but "euroblock" is the closest available connector id in the allowed list — accepts either low-impedance (8ohm) or 70V/100V constant-voltage wiring via a jumper selection, so both signal paths share the same physical terminals. No HDMI/SDI/network/etc. ports exist on this device, and no bandwidth grade applies to any port (analog loudspeaker-level audio, ungraded). Not rack-mountable (column speaker with included pan-tilt bracket).

ports.name: NL4 Input
